say: The same page, now with everything you saw. Top to bottom: think once, look and act for free, one media type on the wire, our own controls in front of theirs. The dotted blue lines are RISE: the watcher and Jenkins answer later, back to ARTIE. The red loop is the only time tokens come back: a form changed, the replay stops, the model repairs. Left: how it was built, test first, gated by hooks, lint on every edit, architecture rules before the turn ends. Right: what it costs, measured. Underneath it all, Fielding's constraints from 2000, with HATEOAS as the gold path and code on demand dashed, because it's the optional one.
